newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize down after Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize down after Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash maize closed mainly lower Friday in good volume trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices dragged down by a sliding Chicago, traders said.

FAS elevator maize lost $2 in Buenos Aires to $100. Cash soybeans were also depressed by a lower nearby Chigago. FAS elevator soybeans lost $6 in Rosario to $269, also in good volume. Sunflower seed prices were unchanged in slow trade.
